reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which matches the rendered output (p0363 is unchanged) — consistent with the expectation that compliant findings carry no negotiation edit.

The cited text supports the rationale: Section 8.3 sets a single self-liquidating term (last Receivable paid/settled/sold/written off, or termination of the Issuer under the Trust Agreement) with no evergreen, successive-term, notice-window or price-uplift mechanic.

Absence of any auto-renewal or non-renewal notice window is favorable to our side (the Servicer cannot unilaterally roll the term forward), so treating the rule as satisfied rather than flagging a deviation avoids over-flagging; classifying as 'missing' would be inappropriate because this securitization transfer and servicing structure does not contemplate a subscription renewal clause.
The failed deterministic check ('non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days — number not found') is expected here: there is no notice window to measure, so the regex miss is not evidence of a defect.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped as internal evaluation evidence; no actionable redline was required or proposed.
